notes.title: Mini Patch 1
notes.content:
Improvements to the surfing mini-game include: changing the maximum speed the player can travel, lighting in the beach scene, and increasing the speed of the animation on the waves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/4dc9057bc4de84ec3b374e2b16a68631ef854d46.png[/img]

The player can now use whichever control system they would prefer in the fishing mini-game. Previously, if a controller was available, the fishing game would default to using that and the player could not use a keyboard or mouse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/44d027101e87fa9914800a1a31befa6cbe7a38f3.png[/img]

Auto Follow Camera added as an option, accessible in the Controls screen.

Fixing clipping bugs while walking over sand dunes. 

The save system displays the last used to save the profile first. 

If you have any more problems, make sure to let us know!

notes.title: CHILL PANDA IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/85f5844b46b977c60d3dde68024eb3afb2eff5b1.jpg[/img]

Panda friends, it’s finally time! We’re delighted to announce that Chill Panda is now available on PC.

From the studio that brought you retro cars flying through space ([i]Space Ribbon[/i]) and the action-packed cult classic race against time to save a monster planet from a robot invasion ([i]Monsteca Corral[/i]), comes a more relaxing divulge into a Panda-inhabited island of Zen and Chill. Join Chill Panda’s adventure and discover a world of cherry blossoms, scenic beaches, and tranquil temples. Learn from science-based anti-anxiety exercises developed by creator and child psychologist Dr. Caroline Belcher and enjoy a calming gameplay with farming, surfing, scooting, and sand castle building to name a few.

Get ready to explore new features such as Panda’s garden and meet new Islanders, with extra missions and mini-games. What’s more, make use of additional customisation, wardrobe options and new shop items with adorable new Panda personalised backpacks and the much coveted Froggy Hat. And last but not least, experience an extended storyline through a mysteriously missing Panda Islander…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/9e2dd41fcbef869a9ad129bbcfad0a98339fab85.jpg[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
* Fill Chill Panda’s Well of Wellbeing by drinking water and chewing bamboo
* Meet the villagers and help them out by farming and clearing the land
* Use your senses to catch fireflies
* Create colourful pictures and decorate Chill Panda’s home
* Earn coins by completing tasks to buy furniture and equipment for Panda’s house and garden
* Release energy at the beach by surfing the waves or banging on the drums
* Personalise Panda with new wardrobe options and backpack customisation
* Collect seeds and grow your own flower garden

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/2cdb89184921ef07f05129fed3c54bbfe5635afd.jpg[/img]

A big thank you from everyone at CGA Studio Games for your continued support! We hope you enjoy Chill Panda and would love for players get involved with our community on Twitter for news/updates @ChillPandaGame / @CGAStudioGames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/b19476ab9db2e72e178d7b9b1b009155b0147794.jpg[/img]
